messages.subject: RE: Caspian Atlas Subscription Agreement — first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Thank you for the draft. Our mark-up is attached. The principal changes are: (1) liability cap increased to 200% of annual fees, with data-protection and personal-data breaches carved out of the cap entirely; (2) payment terms extended to net 45 days; and (3) the non-renewal notice period reduced to 60 days. We've also tightened a few of the warranty provisions.

Happy to discuss on a call this week.

Adam Selby
Partner, Denham Lewis LLP
